candidates.title: Will Lorenzo Musetti win at least 3.5 more games than Ugo Humbert?
candidates.rules_primary: If the game differential in favor of Lorenzo Musetti across the full match is above 3.5 games in the Lorenzo Musetti vs Ugo Humbert professional tennis match in the 2026 ATP Stockholm Quarterfinal, then the market resolves to Yes.
candidates.rules_secondary:
The following market refers to the Lorenzo Musetti vs Ugo Humbert professional tennis match in the 2026 ATP Stockholm Quarterfinal. If the match does not occur (signaled by a ball being played) due to a player injury, walkover, forfeiture, or any other cancellation (all before the match starts), the market will resolve to a fair price in accordance with the rules. If this match is postponed or delayed, the market will remain open and close after the rescheduled match has finished (within two weeks). If a retirement occurs, all markets that can be unconditionally settled based on play already completed will resolve accordingly. Any markets that cannot be unconditionally settled will resolve to Fair Market Price, as determined at the sole discretion of the Exchange.

candidates.title: Cam Skattebo Receptions Ladder
candidates.rules_primary: If Each Yes contract pays $0.05 per reception recorded by Cam Skattebo during the Washington vs New York G Pro Football game originally scheduled for Nov 12, 2026. Each No contract pays $1.00 minus the Yes payout. Yes pays out at most $1.00. Then the market resolves to Yes.
candidates.rules_secondary:
This is a scalar market. The Yes payout per contract is $0.05 per reception constrained between $0.00–$1.00 with a cap at 20 receptions. The No payout is $1.00 minus the Yes payout. Payouts are proportional to the size of the holder's position. For example, 8 receptions pays Yes $0.40 and No $0.60; 11 receptions pays Yes $0.55 and No $0.45; zero receptions pay Yes $0.00 and No $1.00.
